description: Web search powered by DeepSeek's search engine. Returns ranked results with two quality signals: rerank_score (0-3; >=1.5 means highly relevant) and authority (0-4; >=3 means highly authoritative source, -1 unknown). Query syntax: site: (limit to site), -site: (exclude site), -term (exclude word), "exact phrase", -"phrase" (exclude phrase), lang:zh,en (limit languages), after:YYYY or after:YYYY-MM-DD, before:YYYY-MM-DD. By default returns summaries only; set need_content=true to include full page text (larger response).

count.description: Number of results to return, 1-50. Default 10.

localization.description: User IP address used to localize results. Only pass it when appropriate and with consent.

need_content.description: Include full page content per result (truncated at 8000 chars each). Default false.

ori_question.description: The user's original question, if the query was rewritten. Improves intent understanding.

query.description: Search query, 1-128 Unicode chars. Supports site:, lang:, after:/before:, "phrases" and -exclusions.

name: deepseek_search
title: DeepSeek Web Search
